"''Well, they're acting like it.|[[Sabine Wren]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]]|}} '''TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighters''', also known as '''Mining Guild TIE fighters''', were modified [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s that the [[Mining Guild]] was allowed to use due to its association with the [[Galactic Empire]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:MiningGuildTIEs-SWZ.png|thumb|left|250px|TIE/mg starfighters housed in a Mining Guild hangar]] In order to make the [[Starfighter|fighters]] clearly distinct from the ones in [[Imperial Navy|direct service]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], they had a [[Color|yellow]] color scheme. They also had a notch cut in their [[stabilizer]]s, giving them only eight [[solar collector]]s instead of twelve, which gave them improved visibility, but greatly diminished their combat capabilities and maneuverability. They were equipped with basic shielding to protect the investment in the equipment and training of the pilots. The Mining Guild also retrofitted the starfighter with specialized sensors to detect and analyze valuable resources. ==Role== The Mining Guild used TIE/mg starfighters to patrol their territory to prevent theft of valuable materials and gasses, and were also used to locate such materials and gasses. ==History== The TIEs were used at the [[Mining]] Guild's [[Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery]], and saw use as defense during a [[Heist at the Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|heist]] of the refinery undertaken by the [[Spectres|crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]''. In the encounter with the TIE/mg, [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] riding a [[purrgil]]—a spacefaring species capable of traveling through hyperspace, and were said to have been what inspired the early development of the hyperdrive—used his lightsaber to sever one of the wings of a Mining Guild TIE fighter. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|The Call}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into
